title: Select an Explicit Environment Inventory
objectives: Verify the result through independent inspection and explain the observed state.

tasks.instruction: Open Terminal. Run ssh svc_ansible@ansible01, then cd ~/splunk-automation. Commands run inside the virtual environment.
Read inventories/test/hosts.yml. Run ansible all -i inventories/test/hosts.yml --list-hosts. Compare with the default inventory without editing it.

hints: Inspect the affected component or inventory file first.
Use the documented command output to answer the evidence questions.

references.vendorVersion: Ansible inventory reference; bounded core 2.17 compatibility subset

checks.label: Verify successful inspection: ansible all -i inventories/test/hosts.yml --list-hosts

questions.prompt: Which repository-relative inventory path did -i select?

feedback.success: Completion requires verified observations, evidence answers and the required operational state.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect the failed checks; edits on disk may need activation.
